title: Math Tricks
description: Quick mental math tricks, built on things you already know: 4/8 is 50%, so 4/9 is a bit less, and 1/9 is 11.1%, so 4/9 is 44.4%. Nine topics and 45 tricks for fractions, percents, tips, multiplying, squares and roots, estimating and everyday math, each with a step-by-step example, practice with hints, and a 60-second speed round.
controls: Type answers on the on-screen keypad or your keyboard. Enter checks, H shows a hint.
requirements: Any modern browser. Saves stars in this browser.
